usedFor: YourGPT holds chatbot conversations, and LeadConnector receives the person as a contact through “Create Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Message Received” in YourGPT, then “Create Or Update Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: It updates a contact that exists and creates one that does not, so repeat chats stay tidy.

watchOut: “Message Received” runs for every message, so “Create Contact” alone can add the same person more than once.
